title: data.pdf — section 5
text:
5 Supplying, or offering to supply, a psychoactive substance

(1) A person commits an offence if—
(a) the person intentionally supplies a substance to another person,
(b) the substance is a psychoactive substance,
(c) the person knows or suspects, or ought to know or suspect, that the substance
is a psychoactive substance, and
(d) the person knows, or is reckless as to whether, the psychoactive substance is
likely to be consumed by the person to whom it is supplied, or by some other
person, for its psychoactive effects.

(2) A person (“P”) commits an offence if—
(a) P offers to supply a psychoactive substance to another person (“R”), and
(b) P knows or is reckless as to whether R, or some other person, would, if P
supplied a substance to R in accordance with the offer, be likely to consume
the substance for its psychoactive effects.
